title: At Fenmarch, only Prior Halm acknowledges the tithe bargain I struck with the drowned congregation ('Quieter, they tell me, not gone... I can live with quieter'). The eel-trader and the netkeep — the people literally paying 'a tenth of every catch, every year' — have no dialogue referencing it at all when re-visited.
where: The Eel-Market / The Net-Hall, Fenmarch, after 'promise the water a tithe'
